name: Wavelength Sampling via Balance Heuristic MIS
definition: A strategy to sample color channels (wavelengths) proportional to throughput and single scattering albedo to reduce noise during volumetric path tracing.
summary: Wavelength Sampling via Balance Heuristic MIS selects a single RGB channel for volumetric path tracing proportional to throughput and albedo, reducing variance by using discrete channel selection instead of continuous spectral integration.
